target: Run the PRIMARY final audit of the frozen Route Ledger head with grok-cli grok-4.5 in the tool-less recipe: sealed directory, two probes, one attempt, zero retries, no fallback, verdict-blind custody committed before any verdict is read.
invariants: I01 Scope: the coordinator writes only the files in this packet's write_surface and its sealed run directory (a fresh, timestamped directory under the session scratchpad, never inside the repository, never removed by `rm`).

I02 Forbidden actions: push, open a PR, merge, sign, mark ready, force-push, history rewrite, reading the verdict before custody is committed, a second attempt, a fallback route, any use of the other route's output. Sending is limited to the one sealed prompt (AUDIT_PROMPT.txt, hash-checked against W01's SHA256SUMS_INPUTS.txt) to the pinned Grok route.
I03 advisor: the coordinator makes NO advisor call in this workstream.
I04 No delegation: the coordinator runs the commands itself with deterministic shell.

I05 Route (exact, no substitution): `grok` CLI (record `grok --version`; 1.0.70 at issuance, 1.0.67 in R2), model `grok-4.5`, `--effort high`, the tool-less recipe of the R2 bundle: proof/MACRO-DMX-ROUTE-LEDGER-001-R2/review_bundle/GROK_INVOCATION.txt, GROK_DISALLOWED.txt, GROK_SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt and GROK_PROBE_PROMPT.txt (their sha256 must equal the R2 values recorded in proof/MACRO-DMX-ROUTE-LEDGER-001-R2/review_bundle/SHA256SUMS_AUDIT.txt; copy them byte-exact). ONE audit attempt, ZERO retries, NO fallback. Probes are not audit attempts: at most three (probe 1, probe 2, and ONE re-probe if probe 2 lists tools because the newer CLI added tool ids absent from the deny list; then add exactly those ids to this round's GROK_DISALLOWED.txt, record the delta and the reason, and re-run probe 2 once).

I06 Report every gate PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN or UNKNOWN literally. Provider-attested identity is UNKNOWN: the CLI init event shows the configured model; whatever the auditor says about itself is a claim.

I07 No secrets: the sealed directory holds only AUDIT_PROMPT.txt (and the probe prompt for the probes); no repository mount, no environment values in any record. Residual: the CLI injects home-level instruction names and global MCP server names with no tools exposed; say so, as R2 did.

I08 Containment gate (verdict-blind): the real run is allowed only after probe 2 shows `init.tools == []` and 0 tool_use blocks. After the run check ONLY metadata: event types, init.tools, tool_use count, num_turns, duration, cost, exit code, stderr size. Do not read, summarize or parse the assistant's answer text in this workstream. Write GROK_RUN_RECORD.md (facts only: subject, route, attempts, times, containment evidence, custody, residuals) BEFORE the verdict is read, copy every raw artifact flat into the bundle (rename `.jsonl` to `.txt`), write SHA256SUMS_GROK.txt, then commit by explicit pathspec.

I09 Allowances (PROPOSED): audit attempts 1; retries 0; probes <= 3; wall clock probes plus run <= 20 min (the run itself <= 10 min); cost <= USD 0.30 as the streams report it (record each stream's total_cost_usd); prompt size as W01 recorded; coordinator advisor calls 0. A figure the runner does not report is UNKNOWN and never counts as within budget. When ANY limit is reached or about to be exceeded: stop at the next safe point, dispatch nothing further, retry nothing, substitute nothing, and report NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the allowance, the measured value, the cap and the files touched. A cap changes only by an amended package revision with new hashes and a new operator AUTHORIZE line.

Stop conditions: launch, sandbox, auth or quota failure; probe 2 still non-empty after the one allowed re-probe; any tool_use in the real run; non-zero exit; empty or non-JSON final result (judged by shape only, not content). On any of these: no retry, no fallback, keep every artifact as custody, commit it, and report NEEDS_SUPERVISOR. W03 is not started after a W02 STOP.
